title: MIG/TIG Welder
description:
Looking to work in a clean, technical and safe environment? How about a company that has paid their temporary workforce for snow days when the plant was closed?

Our client is a growing pump manufacturing and engineering company located in New Haven. We are seeking MIG/TIG Welders. They will be responsible for various types of weld prep and weld finishing operations to manufacture products per blueprint specifications.

Duties:
  • Use TIG or MIG Pulse welding processes to weld stainless steel components of 304 and 316 metal products.
  • Will be performing pipe welding.
  • Must be able to interpret drawings, blueprints, specifications, sketches, and tolerances.
  • Weld components in flat, vertical, or overhead positions.
  • Monitor the fitting, burning, and welding processes to avoid overheating of parts or warping, shrinking, distortion, or expansion of material.
  • Set up and operate hand and power tools, such as angle grinder, TIG welder and gas metal arc welding equipment.
  • Select proper filler rods according to base metal specifications.
  • Grind or cut edges of work pieces to be joined to ensure snug fit, using angle grinders and hand tools.
  • Detect faulty operation of equipment or defective materials.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
  • Must have TIG welding experience.
  • MIG welding will also be done experience is a plus.
  • Must be willing to learn pipe welding if candidate doesn't already possess previous pipe welding experience.
  • Welding certificates a plus.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GTAW & GMAW-P welding forms and reading blueprints.
  • Experience with modular fixturing a plus.
  • Must be able to read a tape measure and perform simple math
  • Requires use of Protective or Safety Equipment such as shoes, glasses, gloves, etc.
  • Able to work both sitting and standing.
  • Able to lift 50 Pounds.

Pay and Schedule:
$25-$35/hr based on experience
Monday through Friday 7:30-4pm with 30 min lunch
10 vacation days plus 7 PTO days annually

title: Shipping and Receiving Associate
description:
SHIPPING AND RECEIVING ASSOCIATE II
Our client is the world's leading manufacturer of highly-engineered industrial springs, fasteners, bellows, and related metal components. With several manufacturing locations throughout the United States, they design and creates products for a variety of industries, including medical, aerospace, energy, and automotive. Our products can be encountered in many everyday applications, such as driving a car, flying in an airplane, using electronics, or shopping at a grocery store. Through decades of growth, innovation, and dedication, they have proven to be a world-class supplier of custom springs, fasteners, and precision metal components.
JOB SUMMARY
The Shipping and Receiving Associate is responsible for the processing of all daily shipping and packing activities, ensuring timely delivery to our customers. Material Handling to support the plating line.
REPORTING TO
Warehouse Supervisor
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
  • Follow shipping priorities, work assignments, and shipping methods required to meet shipping/receiving schedules and average shipment goal of 40-45 per day, utilizing knowledge of shipping procedures, routes, and rates.
  • Assist Warehouse Supervisor with incoming and outgoing shipping daily activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and condition of shipments.
  • Assist, prepare, and complete orders for delivery or pickup according to schedule and customer specifications (load, pack, wrap, label, ship).
  • Receives, reviews, unpacks, inspects and stores incoming rework orders from suppliers and/or customers returns.
  • Uses ERP system to verify the accuracy of incoming and outgoing shipments and orders and responsible for paperwork internal distribution of, i.e. outgoing product packing slips for shipments and/or labels.
  • Assist other Shipping and Receiving Associates with information and counts, weighs, or measures items of outgoing shipments and to assist verifying against bills of lading, invoices, orders, or other records.
  • Reviews Pick tickets and accurately gathers product from shelves.
  • Conduct physical inventory counts and cycle count as required and report to Warehouse Supervisor and Working Lead of any discrepancies.
  • Perform inventory controls and keep quality standards high for audits.
  • Uses ERP system to verify the accuracy of incoming and outgoing shipments and or existing inventory.
  • Inventory planning for assigned locations within the facility.
  • Follow quality standards and comply with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Keep a clean and safe working environment and optimize space utilization.
  • Other duties as assigned
SKILLS and ABILITIES
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to multitask in a fast pace environment.
  • Excellent knowledge of MS Office and ERP Systems. Visio System preferred.
EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE
  • High School Diploma / GED
  • 3-5 years of experience on warehouse manufacturing in an automated (MRP/ERP) environment.
  • Experience with UPS and FedEx shipping software.
Temp to Perm
Work hours: &:30 to 4:00 (Overtime may be offered)
1 Mandatory 1/2 day saturday, the last Sat. of the month.
Pay: $21 to $22 per hour.

title: Machinist
description:
We are partnered with a large plastics company with over 300 employees. They manufacture many of the plastic containers you would find in your local grocery store. They run 24/7 and offer tremendous stability. In fact, they have a very tenured permanent staff Currently we are seeking CNC Machinists.

Why Work Here:?
  • Very large and stable, growing company.
  • Abenity program that provides employee discounts on items ranging from insurance to cell phones to groceries!
Why Work Here:?
  • Very large and stable, growing company.
  • Discounts on phone bill plus grocery bill.
  • highly tenured internal team.
  • Discounts on pet insurance car insurance.
Responsibilities:
  • Studies blueprints, sketches, drawings, or sample parts to determine dimensions and tolerances of finished work pieces, sequence of operation for fabrication, and setup requirements of work pieces and machine tools.
  • Sets up and operates machine tool such as lathes, milling machines, and surface grinders to fabricate parts and verifies conformance of machined parts to specifications.
  • Calculates and sets controls to regulate machining parameters such as speed, feed, coolant flow, and depth and angle of cut, and/or enters commands to retrieve, input, or edit computerized machine control data.
  • Starts and observes machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining and adjusts machine controls or control media as required.
  • Verifies and documents critical dimensions and alignment of thermoform tool and components assemblies per inspection procedures using calipers, micrometers, height gauges and other measuring instruments.

Qualifications
  • MasterCam or similar software experience is needed.
  • High school diploma or general equivalency degree (GED).
  • Machinist experience with a minimum of five years of experience in machine shop with the ability to demonstrate proficiency in the setup and operation of all shop machine tools, inspection equipment and methods, and tool repair procedures.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of how thermoformed (sheet) plastic is formed is a PLUS.
Pay Rate:
$27-$35 Hourly

Schedule:
Mon - Fri
7:00 AM - 3:30 PM

description:

description:
The Powder Coater will be responsible for applying powder coatings to steel components and assemblies, ensuring quality finish that meets our comapny standards and client specifications. Our ideal candidate will have experience in a manufacturing or fabrication enviornment and possess a strong understanding of powder coating processes and equipment.
Job Functions:

*General assembly work, place labels, insert hardware, etc. Possible use of pneumatic air tools.

*Move product to and from different areas as needed, the use of manual hand trucks and hydraulic assisted hand trucks.
*Maintain a clean work area and keep up supplies needed to complete daily work.
*Other duties as assigned.
Education/Work Experience:
High School diploma or GED and one year of manufactruing experince in a fabrication/powder coating enviornment.
Physical Demands:
*Employee must be able to lift frequently and move, lift up to 50 pounds, anything over 50 pounds will require a team lift. Standing, bending, use of hands/fingers.

Work Hours:
9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday - Friday
Pay: $17 to $17.50 depending on experience
